items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I went for Charles Duranier, where they made some records for him, see.

ctx.x: I was going to ask, would you rather work with the guitar than banjo? Guitar.

Banjo no fit. Banjo, too much that ting ting ting ting ting. See, years ago they had what you call a plectic banjo, the fire station, guys just kick that around the streets. But not in no banjo. Because back I think it was around the 20s when they brought out banjoes, a ton of banjoes. Because that's the same time when they brought out all those saxes that tried to kill the sopranos, that tried to kill the crying eggs. They brought out the sopranos trying to kill violence too, see. Well, they kind of did away a…
I was going to ask a little bit more about slapping the bass, since you're sort of famous for that. Is it really more that you slap at some time, or do you usually just snap at some time?
